title: Interior, closure and boundary of [0, 1)
caption: The set [0, 1) has interior (0, 1) (every point has room around it), closure [0, 1] (the limit point 1 is added) and boundary {0, 1} (the two points where the set meets its complement).
alt: Three number-line rows from −1 to 2: the set [0, 1), its interior (0, 1) and its closure [0, 1], with the boundary points 0 and 1 marked.
description: The set is [0, 1): 0 is included, 1 is not.
